Hymn 299: Children of Our Heavenly Father
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: B-flat Major
Composer: Swedish folk song
Lyricist/Text Author: Carolina Sandell Berg
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 299 titled "Children of Our Heavenly Father" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Swedish folk song and the lyrics were written by Carolina Sandell Berg.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
